newly_imported_proved_external_statement.application: E in X is a disjoint union of affine planes in a smooth fourfold. The base closed set consists of N reduced points in A2. Projection is smooth,and E is its full inverse image;the rank-two complex normal map is an isomorphism. Thus each relative four-disk boundary maps to its own base link with degree+1. Equivalently use ordinary tubular excision and the oriented rank-four Thom isomorphism;no global section or properness is required.
